title: Monday Code Migrate
tagline: Migrate existing apps to the monday-code platform
features: Analyzes existing project structure and detects frameworks automatically
Presents a migration plan for approval before making any changes
Adds monday SDK integration, auth middleware, and deployment config
Works with any frontend build tool (Vite, Webpack, esbuild, Parcel, CRA)
Supports frontend-only, backend-only, or fullstack migrations
Preserves existing code and business logic — only adds monday-code compatibility
prerequisites: An existing frontend and/or backend application
